dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents full quarter sections within Milwaukee County. The associated maps show engineering and tax information about parcels within the county and its municipalities. The source portal states that the dataset is updated as needed. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
